overview.tool_name: Grok API, Grok via X Premium (Basic / Standard / Plus), SuperGrok & SuperGrok Heavy
overview.plan_tier: X Premium Basic / X Premium / X Premium+ / SuperGrok / SuperGrok Heavy / Grok API
overview.policy_reference: ReSolve Compliance Manual §VIII.G; ReSolve Artificial Intelligence Policy (Orion)

tool_description: ReSolve uses xAI’s Grok across multiple surfaces. The Grok API (api.x.ai) provides programmatic access under enterprise terms with contractual commitments that customer data is not used for training. X Premium tiers (Basic, Standard, Plus) provide conversational Grok access through the X platform; these are consumer plans where model training is ON by default and users must manually disable the training toggle in X Settings > Privacy and Safety > Grok. SuperGrok and SuperGrok Heavy are standalone subscriptions at grok.com that default to NOT training on conversations (opt-in model). All tiers include image generation via Grok’s Aurora model. Use is restricted to corporate devices only, per ReSolve’s AI policy in Orion. Note: xAI is a relatively young company (founded 2023); enterprise compliance infrastructure is still maturing compared to larger peers.

Programmatic data analysis and content generation via the Grok API

use_cases.text: Generating images for internal presentations and research reports using Grok’s Aurora image model,

use_cases: Brainstorming, ideation, and general research queries via Grok on X or SuperGrok
Deep research and extended reasoning via SuperGrok Heavy’s Grok 4 Heavy model

data_protection.details: Consumer plans (Basic, Standard, Plus): training is ON by default. Users must manually toggle off via X Settings > Privacy and Safety > Data sharing and personalization > Grok. The X Terms of Service grant xAI a broad license to use Content for training unless this setting is disabled.

Standalone grok.com subscriptions default to NOT training on conversations. Users must explicitly opt in via Settings > Data Controls > “Improve the model.” Private Chat mode is available for ephemeral conversations.
Disabled. xAI contractually commits not to use business data (inputs or outputs) for training models under the Enterprise Terms of Service. Zero Data Retention policy applies.
TLS encryption for all connections. Specific TLS version and cipher suites are not publicly documented for consumer tiers.

Data encrypted at rest across all tiers. Specific algorithms not publicly documented for consumer tiers. Enterprise Vault add-on (API/Enterprise) provides Customer-Managed Encryption Keys (CMEK) with physically isolated infrastructure.

Conversations deleted within 30 days after user deletion. Private Chat mode prevents saving to history and triggers 30-day deletion. Human-reviewed conversations (subset for safety) may be retained up to 3 years, disconnected from account.
Inputs and outputs automatically deleted within 30 days unless legally required. Enterprise customers can negotiate custom retention terms in writing.

Primary processing in the United States (Memphis, TN data centers; AWS infrastructure). No user-configurable data residency options. International transfers governed by Standard Contractual Clauses via the DPA.
Grok API: API key-based access. X Premium tiers: X account authentication. SuperGrok: standalone account at grok.com. No enterprise-grade IAM, SSO, or audit logging for consumer tiers.

certifications.status: Compliant — Grok API and Grok Business/Enterprise. Consumer tiers (X Premium, SuperGrok) are not in audit scope.
Not publicly confirmed — no evidence of ISO 27001 certification in xAI documentation.
Compliant — API and Business/Enterprise tiers. DPA with Standard Contractual Clauses available.
Supported for Enterprise tier only — BAA available upon request. Not available for consumer or SuperGrok tiers.
